root_cause.text: During garbage collection, the `ra_data_block` function in `fs/f2fs/gc.c` initiates a read I/O on an encrypted page without checking if it is already marked as uptodate, leading to a kernel BUG in `folio_end_read` upon I/O completion.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (folio_test_uptodate(efolio)) goto put_encrypted_page;` in `ra_data_block` before calling `f2fs_submit_page_bio(&fio)` to avoid initiating I/O on already updated pages, which previously triggered the `VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_test_uptodate(folio))` crash in `folio_end_read`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Avoid submitting redundant I/O requests for encrypted folios that are already up-to-date.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check using `folio_test_uptodate(efolio)` to bypass bio submission if the encrypted folio is already up-to-date.
intent_record.how: Prevents redundant I/O operations by skipping `f2fs_submit_page_bio` and jumping directly to releasing the page reference if the data is already valid in memory.
